balanceGate.amount: Canonical nonnegative decimal-string balance is compared as BigInt against the selected positive atomic amount. No Number rounding, token-decimal rescaling or arbitrary uint256 balance ceiling. Explicit zero cannot cover the selected positive amount.
balanceGate.unavailable: Missing/null maps or selected entries are refused, never treated as zero/usable funds or replaced by unreceived/mailbox data. Native construction may omit an entry when token metadata is unavailable.
balanceGate.boundaries: AccountInfo has no chain ID or frontier hash. Both it and the account frontier are caller-supplied DATA. Equal payer/height is NOT source authentication, exact-state binding, atomicity, freshness, canonical funds or spendability proof.
balanceGate.projectionOnly: Other token metadata and unselected entries are bounded JSON, not fully token/account validated. A different declared nonzero frontier hash with the same projected fields intentionally produces the same balance DATA receipt and NOT_ESTABLISHED flags.
balanceGate.encoding: Reuse the bounded duplicate/key/depth/UTF8 JSON scanner and captured native numeric-source parsing. accountHeight must be an exact canonical positive safe integer lexeme matching the declared frontier. Raw input is at most65536 JavaScript characters AND65536 UTF8 bytes; the local id1 wrapper is syntax reuse, not RPC correlation.
